body.name: \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm{low}}\)
body.construction: Freeze \(p_x\), \(f_x=f^{\circ}\), and two nonidentical asymmetric error laws; relocate the compact-support Legendre moment-annihilating packet from the latent density to a Bernoulli conditional mark, preserve strict \(H^{\beta}\) slack and the Bernoulli range, retain factorial attenuation in the observed marked channel, and apply the confidence-band testing reduction.
